criteria.detail: Root-only summary requests are output-verified and render a success-toned Check with sr-only Done and title tooltip, without visible Done/output prose; both screenshots visibly show root check icons.
ChildThreadRow has no summary/completion input or Done render path. Both screenshots show three quiet children with neutral glyphs/connectors and no Done text or completion badges.

Current source maps PR states to semantic icons and renders presentation.icon plus #number inside UrlLink, with state/title in aria-label and title only. This is source/test evidence; the screenshots do not depict or claim a live PR.

familyWaitingForAgents selects the root Loading activity icon and primary connector tint, while a live child is represented only by ThreadStateGlyph; no visible Agents working or duplicate child status rendering remains.

Root ThreadStatusLabel always renders relative age, while existing left status glyphs carry accessible labels. PR, Done, and family-activity icon states have accessible text/labels and native title tooltips.

Pure selectors enforce root activity→PR→verified completion and child live-glyph→PR precedence. useThreadSummaries receives only the root, and the child renderer cannot fetch or present completion output.

The feature diff is confined to metadata/state presentation and root-only summary selection; navigation, context menu, split, hierarchy controls, connector geometry, filters, deletion safety, project creation, shelves, and compact routing remain present. Focused and clean-archive receipts pass.

Focused tests cover semantic PR presentation and root/child precedence, all five QA receipts pass on the current HEAD/tree without anomalies, and independently inspected wide/compact artifacts match receipt hashes and show icon-only roots plus three quiet children without Done badges.

summary: Passed all AC-1 through AC-8. Current source and tests establish root checks, root-only completion truth, semantic PR icon+# rendering, glyph-only child live status, accessibility, and preserved behavior; the verified wide/compact screenshots confirm the required quiet-family presentation without being used as evidence of a live PR state.
